label: Opportunity area
definition: A large area designated or promoted for growth, such as a GLA Opportunity Area.

label: Cluster
definition: A group of neighbouring sites promoted together as one investment opportunity.

label: Site
definition: A single development site, which may hold one or more buildings.

label: Mineral extraction
definition: A site where minerals such as sand and gravel are or will be extracted, usually followed by restoration.

label: Infrastructure
definition: A route or network, such as a railway line or heat network, that serves several places rather than sitting within one.

label: Building
definition: An existing or proposed building, usually shown in a 3D model.
